title: Genetic drift in a small population
intro: Each generation, 2N gene copies are drawn at random from the parents' gene pool, so an allele's frequency wanders even when it gives no advantage. Change the population size, the starting frequency and the selection coefficient, and watch 200 populations: how many end with the allele fixed, how many lose it, and how fast the heterozygosity fades.
sLabel: Selection coefficient s (AA 1 + s, Aa 1 + s/2)
pathsTitle: Frequency of A in five of the populations
